# captured 2026-09-22
# exe: /home/ubuntu/.local/bin/mise
# args: 
mise installs the dev tools your projects need, sets their environment
variables, and runs their tasks.

Tools, env vars, and tasks are declared in mise.toml. `mise use <TOOL>` adds a
tool to the project in the current directory, `mise install` installs everything
the config asks for, and `mise run <TASK>` runs a task. Docs:
https://mise.jdx.dev

Usage: mise [FLAGS] [TASK] [SUBCOMMAND]

Commands:
  activate      Print the script to activate mise in an interactive shell
  backends      Manage backends [aliases: b, backend, backend-list]
  bin-paths     List all the active runtime bin paths
  bootstrap     Set up a machine from the current configuration [aliases: bs]
  cache         Manage the mise cache
  completion    Generate shell completions [aliases: complete, completions]
  config        Manage config files [aliases: cfg, toml]
  daemons       [experimental] Manage project daemons with pitchfork [aliases:
                daemon]
  deactivate    Print the script to disable mise in the current shell session
  deps          [experimental] Manage project dependencies [aliases: dep,
                prepare]
  doctor        Check mise installation for possible problems [aliases: dr]
  dotfiles      Manage dotfiles from `[dotfiles]` [aliases: dot]
  edit          Edit mise.toml interactively
  en            Start a new shell with the mise environment built from the
                current configuration
  env           Print the environment for the current configuration [aliases: e]
  exec          Execute a command with tool(s) set [aliases: x]
  fmt           Format mise TOML configuration
  generate      Generate files for various tools/services [aliases: gen, g]
  implode       Remove the mise CLI and all related data
  install       Install a tool version [aliases: i]
  install-into  Install a tool version to a specific path
  latest        Resolve the latest matching version request for a tool
  link          Symlink a tool version into mise [aliases: ln]
  lock          Create or refresh lockfile versions, checksums, and download
                URLs
  ls            List installed and active tool versions [aliases: list]
  ls-remote     List tool versions available to install [aliases: list-all,
                list-remote]
  mcp           Run the Model Context Protocol server over stdin/stdout
  oci           [experimental] Build OCI container images from a mise.toml
  outdated      Show outdated tool versions
  packslip      The signers mise accepts packslips from
  patrons       Show the individuals supporting mise as Patron-tier members
  plugins       Manage plugins [aliases: p, plugin, plugin-list]
  prune         Delete unused versions of tools
  registry      List registry shorthand names and their backends
  reshim        Create shims for executables provided by installed tools
  run           Run tasks and their dependencies [aliases: r]
  search        Search for available tools
  self-update   Update mise itself
  set           Set environment variables in mise.toml [aliases: ev, env-vars]
  settings      Manage settings
  shell         Set a tool version for the current shell session [aliases: sh]
  shell-alias   Manage shell aliases
  skills        Agent skills the active tools ship, from their packslips
                [aliases: skill]
  sponsors      Show the companies sponsoring mise and the jdx.dev open source
                tools
  ssh           Open an SSH session, optionally borrowing read-only GitHub
                access
  sync          Synchronize tools from other version managers with mise
  tasks         Manage tasks [aliases: t, task]
  test-tool     Test that a tool installs and runs
  token         Display git provider tokens mise will use
  tool          Show information about a tool
  tool-alias    Manage tool version aliases [aliases: alias, aliases]
  tool-stub     Execute a tool stub
  trust         Mark a config file as trusted
  uninstall     Remove installed tool versions
  unset         Remove environment variable(s) from the config file
  untrust       Remove explicit trust for a config
  unuse         Remove tool requests from configuration and prune unused
                installations [aliases: rm, remove]
  upgrade       Upgrade outdated tools [aliases: up]
  use           Install a tool and add it to configuration [aliases: u]
  version       Display the version of mise [aliases: v]
  watch         Run task(s) and rerun them when files change [aliases: w]
  where         Display the installation path for a tool
  which         Show the path a tool's executable resolves to
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Arguments:
  [TASK]  Task to run.

          Shorthand for `mise tasks run <TASK>`.

Flags:
  -C, --cd <DIR>     Change directory before running command
  -E, --env <ENV>    Set the environment for loading `mise.<ENV>.toml`
  -j, --jobs <JOBS>  How many jobs to run in parallel; values below 1 are
                     treated as 1 [default: 8]
                     [env: MISE_JOBS]
  -q, --quiet        Suppress non-error messages
                     [env: MISE_QUIET]
  -v, --verbose      Show extra output (use -vv for even more)
  -y, --yes          Answer yes to all confirmation prompts
      --no-config    Do not load any config files

                     Can also use `MISE_NO_CONFIG=1`
      --no-env       Do not load environment variables from config files

                     Can also use `MISE_NO_ENV=1`
      --no-hooks     Do not execute hooks from config files

                     Can also use `MISE_NO_HOOKS=1`
      --raw          Read/write directly to stdin/stdout/stderr instead of by
                     line
      --locked       Require lockfile URLs to be present during installation

                     Fails if tools don't have pre-resolved URLs in the lockfile
                     for the current platform.
                     This prevents API calls to GitHub, aqua registry, etc.
                     Can also be enabled via MISE_LOCKED=1 or
                     settings.locked=true
      --silent       Suppress all task output and mise non-error messages
  -h, --help         Print help

Examples:
    Install a specific node version
    $ mise install node@20.0.0
    Install a version matching a prefix
    $ mise install node@20
    Install the node version defined in config
    $ mise install node
    Install all plugins/tools defined in config
    $ mise install
    Install something via cargo
    $ mise install cargo:ripgrep
    Install something via npm
    $ mise install npm:prettier
    Use node-20.x in current project
    $ mise use node@20
    Use node-20.x as default
    $ mise use -g node@20
    Use latest node in current directory
    $ mise use node@latest
    Show a menu to upgrade tools
    $ mise up --interactive
    Run npm install with config loaded into PATH
    $ mise x -- npm install
    Run node app.js with config and node-20.x on PATH
    $ mise x node@20 -- node app.js
    Set NODE_ENV=production in config
    $ mise set NODE_ENV=production
    Run build tasks
    $ mise run build
    Run build tasks repeatedly when files change
    $ mise watch build
    Show settings in use
    $ mise settings
    Disable color by modifying global config file
    $ mise settings color=0

Author: Jeff Dickey <@jdx>
